title: An Election
author: John Scalzi
note: conf=0.82; Short story (~2010, Subterranean Press, posted on Scalzi's Whatever blog; ebook edition Jan 2012, also sold as "An Election Story" on Kobo). Set in the "Third District" — Goodreads lists a 2-book Third District series: An Election (2010, #1) and Constituent Service (2024/2025, #2, an indirect sequel). The numbering is by publication order per Goodreads; the story itself was not marketed as a numbered volume when first released.
